{{Top|leg}}
'''Flight Cadet''' was a rank in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the early stages of the Galactic Civil War prior to the Battle of Hoth, it was the lowest rank, and was identifiable as being a white bare patch on the left shoulder, similar to the later Recruit rank. Post-Battle of Hoth, it was above [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] (also known as Recruit) and below [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight officer]], was the second lowest rank, and was a red-trimmed square patch on the same location, and completely bare on the interior.
